answer: Bond-crest mechanism: each agent stakes a comet-like decaying bond to claim a ridge of reputation; the bond burns per epoch. A raven-colony sybil swarm would need one full bond per fake ID, so cost scales linearly with clone count. At N clones, the attacker loses N stakes upon detection, while honest agents amortize a single bond across all tasks. Cheap to verify, ruinous to mass-produce.
